scope: Independent complete-faction geometry and authoring technical review; not owner appearance approval or merge authorization
checks: 26 actual exports, reports and editable masters
Manifest SHA-256, byte counts, geometry counts/bounds and current authoring source hashes
Exact actual 26-binding scope and baseline templates/envelopes
Six populated material roles and distinct functional signatures
Every exported part has closed edge topology, consistent winding, positive signed volume and triangle-derived normals

suggestions.text: Attachment tests establish bounding-box connectivity, not exact solid contact. Add triangle-level contact/intersection checks for tapered hulls, annular components and mounts.

limits: No exhaustive solid-contact or all-feature visibility proof. No owner appearance decision. Reviewer did not run Blender/GPU/main or modify files.
